scope.allocation_cost: Costs cover only the listed runtime-matrix allocations and startup failures. Collector validation, development, confirmation, scoring and the separate long recovery allocation are accounted elsewhere; this is not the global compute ledger.
scope.budget: Unchanged observed owned-process 24GiB predicate; missing host evidence remains false and within-budget remains null. Sampled peaks are lower bounds, not physical 24GB-hardware qualification.
scope.history: All earlier stopped cells and startup failures remain separate. Later decoder versions do not repair historical flags.
scope.host: Owned process RSS/PSS and rank allocator telemetry do not measure total host residency or unmapped filesystem page cache.
scope.native: Twenty optimizer updates per completed cell, effective batch eight, two warmup updates; distinct four-update recovery suites where actually completed.
scope.preprocessing: Last captured cumulative counters can include initial and scheduled validation; processing and waiting overlap execution and must not be summed as wall time.
scope.quality: Runtime stress only. Long targets are synthetic sequence stress, not task-quality evidence.
scope.selection: Original full/no-AC combined execution selection remains incomplete. No fastest-recipe selection or best-fit qualification is produced.
scope.shape_evidence: CPU processor measurements cover the prepared training and validation rows. Native update metrics verify corresponding examples and supervised tokens; fresh reload probes inspect the first prepared video row. Processed temporal slots do not establish unique decoded source frames.
scope.timing: Single cell observations, not repeated matched confidence intervals. Complete cell elapsed includes verification, training, publication and probes; separately reported recovery and outer allocation setup are additional.

allocation_cost.scope: This separate recovery allocation only; allocated CPU hours belong to this GPU job. Queue wait and global experiment cost are not included.

scope.checkpoint_comparison: Exact native comparisons were executed in the GPU allocation; this replay verifies their own commands, zero tolerances, logs and update metrics.
scope.cost_scope: Four-update recovery costs only; no throughput comparison or300-update quality claim.
scope.shape_scope: CPU workload preparation covers all32/8 rows. Native metrics verify32 training sequences and corresponding supervised-token counts per uninterrupted four-update trajectory; fresh reload probes verify the first long video row. Temporal slots do not establish unique decoded source frames.

unsubmitted_combined_profile.scope: Prepared shapes do not constitute executed native evidence.
